notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes 9/2
notes.notes:
[list]
[b]Relic Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where the relic [i]Stone of Wilting[/i] could cause poison in future runs
[*] Fixed a math bug with the relic [i]Weakening Strength[/i] would cause the player to deal negative damage
[*] Fixed a bug where the relic [i]Veil of Aging[/i] would be unpurchasable in the shop or unpickupable from a pickup item

[b] Other Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where some relics get removed from the pool in future rounds, breaking the shop & chests
[*] Fixed a UI issue in Relic Shops when, upon opening a shop, the text may be red even if you have enough coins for the relic
[/list]
